venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Cooler evening, first feel of winter
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 11/12 (MOD MKZ/JK; entered by Daniel; posted 12:36am 11/13)** Net $1,963 vs target $1,732 (113%). Food $293; comps $0. 61 guests; check avg $32.18. Good large push at open, steady until ~7pm; lull at 7, picked back up ~10pm. Large party bought ping pong balls and played beer pong. Several international guests loved the cocktails and plan to return for Friday's DJ. Val training on the centrifuge. Low simple syrup. No maintenance; no incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 11/12 (MOD KK/KE/MD, Chef JMS; entered by JO; posted 2:07am 11/13)** Net $9,074 vs target $1,918 (473%). Event sales $9,004 (form; exceeds the non-event share implied by net — figures as reported); food $1,500; comps $59 (0.7%; event comp, employee). Guests ~80 (more with event) and check avg $23.38 — form notes both are not accurate with the event. Chi Omega (Sigma Epsilon chapter) Fall Formal buyout; well organized check-in, food fully cleared, ~$1,100 additional bev sales as expected. Little business before/after the event. Maintenance: walk-in cooler (repair call already placed by Kira). 86: keg CO2, Ponies, Super Martini, Guinness draft (until tomorrow). No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 11/12 (AM & PM MOD Maggie S; entered by MS; posted 2:57am 11/13)** Net $15,700 incl. events; daily target reported n/a. AM (coffee) $1,287, D&C PM $14,413; event (Search Ministries, 15 guests, suite 6A) $3,780 = food $2,220 + bev $1,560. Food $2,126 (form 'incl. events' equals non-event food; event food $2,220 reported separately). Comps $470 (gifts, one couple's check covered because the large group monopolized service time). 266 guests (Tock); check avg $59.02 (net/guests). Full from 3:30 to ~5pm, dinner lull, then a walk-in group from the 'What's Next?' event at Mission Ballroom grew from 25–30 to 50+ (incl. members of Congress, NFL Hall of Famers) — ~$3K in cocktails in 2 hours; last call moved up to 10:30 because the room was full. AM: calm morning, pops from noon on; restocked chai, evergreen, mocha, caramel. Kitchen: busy Thursday, event cheese course and taco bar. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 11/12 (MOD Jane, Chef Steves; entered by stef; posted 2:12am 11/13)** Net $5,433 vs target $5,649 (96%). Food $833, beverage $4,600; comps $102.74 (1.9%). 134 guests (SevenRooms); check avg $40.54 (net/guests; form $41). Very slow first half — heavy rain all day and first real cold day; touch-and-go floor, but cold drove more rounds. Mostly 2-tops plus a party of 9 across both big booths; a couple of investors; no waitlist; room never fully filled but good turns; last party sat 1:15am. Top sellers: Rosalie, Tripwire/Shinebox (tie), Burner Phone. One no-show (not charged). Breakage: coupe, DOF. Menu count 17/17.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 11/12 (MOD Gigi, Chef Josh; entered by Gigi; posted 4:36am ET 11/13)** Net $6,070 vs target $5,539 (110%). All Marquee; no Standing Room or events. Food $1,221; comps $34 (1 DNL, anniversary bubbles). 162 guests; check avg $37.47 (net/guests — form reported $83.28, which doesn't reconcile with net). Very slow start (Enoch's first official server shift), then hit hard ~10pm by a walk-in wave from a show at the Moroccan (reported surprise Justin Bieber appearance); many first-timers, strong last call for food and drinks; lots of service compliments. Met the owners of Seven Waves Cachaça. Maintenance: oven still down; hand sink fixed; soap dispenser arriving tomorrow. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 11/12 (MOD Marcus; entered by Marcus; posted 2:29am 11/13)** Net $4,442.48 (form 'Total Net Sales Including Events') vs target $4,713 (94%). Marquee bar / total sales $4,897.03 (form); food $317.65; discounts $145.18 (member/investor 10%, F&F 15%, gift, rang-wrong item, tasting comp). 145 guests (96 walk-in / 49 resos; 57 on the books); check avg $30.64 (net/guests; form $32.43). Slow start, picked up ~7pm, kept building past 9pm with groups from a lawyers' convention who wanted to stand and mingle rather than seated service; pulled Tyler back onto the floor. **Incident reported:** a guest's hair caught fire from the candle at table 36 (reportedly unfazed). Light kitchen night; potatoes top seller. Michael and Jayla training. Takeaway: get an insider for conventions/meetings. Maintenance: curtain. No-shows not charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 11/12 (AM Sam & Lex; PM James & Drew; entered by Alexis; posted 2:35am 11/13)** Net $8,424 vs target $8,817 (96%). Morning bar $992, evening bar $5,800, Hot Eye $1,467; Sun Club closed; no events; food $2,645; comps $209. 155 guests (38 AM + 117 PM OpenTable); check avg $54.35 (net/guests). Quiet morning (2 food tours, small lunch 11–1); team sorted new glassware. Evening: busy happy hour, sleepy lull that emptied the room, then a busy finish with many groups arriving at once 9–9:30 (cocktails slowed on volume only). Hot Eye: steady flow at bar and booths, birthdays and industry. Kitchen steady, no send-backs, no 86s. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Thursday 11/12 (MOD Curtis Hayes; entered by Curtis Hayes; posted 4:10am 11/13)** Net $9,523 vs target $11,038 (86%). Food $1,490; comps $259.70 (2.7%; 3 DNLs, a couple service recoveries). 210 guests; check avg $45.35. A few guests waiting at open but no strong opening bump; first hit ~5pm, lull, another hit ~7, late hit 9:30–10pm that the bar crushed with 2 bartenders. No big spenders; lots of slow tables to flip. Early cuts for door and barback. Kitchen did ~$1.5K and is prepped heavy for the 11/14 event. Re-up all bar 86s tomorrow. No maintenance; no incidents; no-shows charged.
